title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector of [0.6381, 0.3611, 0.0]. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In this sketch, start by drawing the first line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.1119, 0.0). Continue by drawing the second line from (0.1119, 0.0) to (0.1119, 0.0746), then the third line from (0.1119, 0.0746) to (0.0, 0.0746), and finally, the fourth line from (0.0, 0.0746) back to the origin. Scale the two-dimensional sketch using a scale factor of 0.1119. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three-dimensional space by applying the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] for rotation and the translation vector [0.6381, 0.3611, 0.0] for movement. Extrude the two-dimensional sketch along the normal direction by 0.0895 units, ensuring that no extrusion occurs in the opposite direction. This process will create a new solid body with a length of 0.11193606368913307 units, a width of 0.07462404245942204 units, and a height of 0.08954885095130646 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.1119, 0).lineTo(0.1119, 0.0746).lineTo(0, 0.0746).close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the cube
cube = sketch.extrude(0.0895)

# Apply the translation
cube = cube.translate((0.6381, 0.3611, 0))

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cube

# Define the initial coordinate system transformation
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY").transformed(offset=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0895))

# Create the sketch for the rectangular face

    workplane
    .lineTo(0.1119, 0.0)  # line_1
    .lineTo(0.1119, 0.0746)  # line_2
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0746)  # line_3
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0)  # line_4
    .close()  # Close the loop
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the rectangular box
r = sketch.extrude(0.0895)

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch for the top face of the object
top_face = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0.0, 0.0).lineTo(0.1119, 0.0).lineTo(0.1119, 0.0746).lineTo(0.0, 0.0746).close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the body of the object
body = top_face.extrude(0.0895)

# Define the sketch for the cutout on the left side
left_cutout = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(-0.0100, -0.0100).circle(0.0100).extrude(-0.0200, combine=False)

# Cut the left side of the body
body = body.cut(left_cutout)

# Define the sketch for the cutout on the right side
right_cutout = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0.1219, -0.0100).circle(0.0100).extrude(-0.0200, combine=False)

# Cut the right side of the body
body = body.cut(right_cutout)

# Final model
r = body
